name: isaStatusline
description: config.json for the ISA statusLine (next to harness.ts)

mode.description: 'auto' picks compact vs wide from the terminal's reported column count; 'compact'/'wide' pin it regardless of width

color.description: Master color switch. NO_COLOR, if set in the environment, always wins over this.

isaBin.description: Path to the `isa` launcher. $ISA_BIN wins; default ~/.local/bin/isa.
